meta.title: Shanghai Area Rental, Commute, Amenities & Utilities Base Data (上海)
meta.rent_method: Sampling of live listings on the Anjuke (安居客) platform (2026-09-22, ~60 listings); same methodology for whole-unit and shared rentals; ranges are reference ranges from listing samples, not rental statistics
meta.commute_method: Estimated from Shanghai Metro official network transfer routes: 2.5 min per segment + 6 min per transfer + 12 min out-of-station walking/waiting, rounded to 5 min; not measured with a map app; queried 2026-09-22

data_status_values.sample_reference: Reference range from listing samples, not statistical; usable for "current estimate"-style area reference, must be presented to the user as a sample range
data_status_values.estimated: Network-based estimate, not measured; presented as an estimate
data_status_values.pending_verification: Not verified item by item; the product must label it "pending verification"
data_status_values.legacy_corroborated: Cited from pre-2024 official documents, with corroborating evidence it is still current; source and timeliness must be labeled
